runtime_provenance.note: Snapshot plus overlays were used because ROS runtime is built in a temporary Linux path without Windows spaces. Failed initial harness log is retained locally; it is not a passing result.

limitations: No mission goal was sent in the physical wrapper smoke; stop/replan/reauthorize/route execution and complete mission acceptance remain open.
The historical physical scenario CLI now delegates to the wrapper; its complete sortie was not executed in this correction cut.
No DEM-derived offset is applied to authoritative telemetry. A real physical/planner height mismatch remains an explicit refusal.
RouteDecision reserve fields are estimated residuals; requested mission reserve enforcement needs the proper mission/context consumer.
Scene lookup is synthetic, not Gazebo camera/LiDAR perception; landing samples the current footprint rather than relabelling historical flight coverage.
Legacy planning is an explicit MOCK opt-in; scientific registered-context and coefficient approvals are not supplied by this wrapper.
No submission or organizer endorsement is claimed.
